\newcommand{\fullGatesSentence}{All 54 gates pass. The run of all of them was made at commit 2857279. The check was corrected in commit 2c71442, the only change to \code{src/}, \code{tests/} and \code{mutants/} between the two commits, and S51 was then run again alone, at the commit of the other measurements of this report; the record of the table for S51 is that of the second run. The logs, one record per gate, are in the supplementary material.}
